It assumed each color square in the palette corresponded to exactly one domino, leading it to conclude only one domino was green — despite the scene description explicitly stating all 10 dominoes were green. This reflects a fundamental misreading of visual hierarchy: the model fixated on the legend while ignoring the primary content (the dominoes themselves) and their sequential appearance.

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed because it misinterpreted the color palette as a count of dominoes rather than a visual aid for identifying the target color. The model ignored the sequential appearance of 10 green dominoes and the explicit scene description stating all 10 were green. This is a major perceptual and logical failure rooted in misprioritizing interface elements over primary content.
